text: I feel a sense of anticipation being in this modern and brightly lit space. The clean glass walls and the arrangement of practical objects like the fire extinguisher evoke thoughts about the constructed nature of order and safety. Entering the R+D area, the wall of ideas and technology, coupled with colorful, pixelated maps and digital screens, makes me reflect on human ambition and innovation—our tireless quest to understand and reshape the world. There is excitement here, but also a subtle awe at the complexity and interconnectedness of knowledge.
